not_found: Diabetes UK board and the Diabetes Technology Network-UK committee page could not be read (abcd.care/dtn-uk returned 404; only the DTN-UK chair title appears, on the DUKPC speakers page). Dr Emma Wilmot's DTN-UK chair role was not read on a page in this session.
The ABCD committee page lists four officers only; other ABCD committee members are not named on it.

DUKPC speakers page is headed 2027 speakers and also lists 2026 speakers; roles recorded are 'speaker' in the section shown. Lived-experience speakers, trainees, charity staff, non-UK and non-clinical speakers were not listed to stay near the cap, so the list is a selection of the more senior UK clinical and academic speakers.
The page lists no keynote or plenary label; no one is marked plenary.
Primary Care Diabetes Society and the Diabetes Specialist Nurse Forum committees were not read.
LinkedIn matching not done: web search allowance exhausted in this session, so no profile could be verified.
